decisions.reason: The budget state already records the $9,990 allocation under the combined FCC_FH entity; the site-name clarification changes no budget value, key, or scope.
The schedule state already associates the 7/20 through 8/13 dates with FCC_FH, so the site-name clarification requires no schedule update or removal.
Clarifying that FCC and FH are the same school does not change the required four-week value or establish a different weeks-served scope.
The signature requirement applies only to Queens Collegiate and JHS 157 at this time and is unaffected by the FCC/FH naming clarification.
The explanation requirement concerns the distinction between a full allocation and a subcontract amount for Queens Collegiate, not whether FCC and FH are the same school.
The clarification does not add FCC/FH to the requested support-sheet scope or otherwise change the support-sheet deliverable.
The FCC/FH identity clarification changes neither the session-count calculation rule nor the existing Queens Collegiate, JHS 157, or 154Q/201 calculation attributes.
